mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 84 degree temperatures out by Badger Prairie County Park, with a full moon tonight and an air quality index of 58.

The city has two big updates. First, the intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will be closed August 5 through 7 for sewer work. Second, you have until August 7 to vote online for the student-designed I Voted stickers for the upcoming election.
Today is packed with activities like the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee, plus don't forget the Concerts in the Park tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on July 26, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for O W I after the driver was caught traveling 97 miles per hour.
Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. You can also catch Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 4:30 PM or at the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
